name: Trade Query Criteria 10
definition: Query criteria on a trade transaction.

TradeLifeCycleHistory.name: Trade Life Cycle History
TradeLifeCycleHistory.definition: Indicates whether the response must include all reports submitted for a trade (true) or only the current state of the trade (false).||Usage:|If false is selected, the reporting timestamp element must be absent.

OutstandingTradeIndicator.name: Outstanding Trade Indicator
OutstandingTradeIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the response must include all trades  (false) or only the outstanding trades (true).

TradeTypeCriteria.name: Trade Type Criteria
TradeTypeCriteria.definition: Query criteria related to transaction types.

TimeCriteria.name: Time Criteria
TimeCriteria.definition: Query criteria related to time values.

OtherCriteria.name: Other Criteria
OtherCriteria.definition: Query criteria related to other fields.
